decision.invalidation: Thesis fails if BoC hikes or the 1m CORRA strip through Dec-2026 reprices toward the 2027 CRA mid-3s; if CPI-trim/median leave the 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment stops contracting and wages re-accelerate; or if CORRA_2027-03 implied holds at or above the 3.13 entry because catch-up is actually being delivered. A US-only or energy-headline move that leaves CRAH27 unchanged is not invalidation. Wrong timing, not wrong thesis, if implieds chop around 3.13 without a new BoC hike signal.

portfolio_construction.adverse_scenario: Main adverse for the CURRENT book is a Canada catch-up selloff in CRAH27: BoC delivers or credibly signals the priced 2027 mid-3s path, trim/median leave 1.9/2.0, labor reverses the -42k contraction, and/or the 1m strip through Dec-2026 (COAZ26 2.58) reprices toward CRA mid-3s. Standard 100bp rise in the owned implied mark costs about 4.5m shocked P&L. Global hawkish clustering (Fed delivered, BoJ 1.25%, BoE 6-3) is a transmission channel into that CA catch-up, not a separate shock unless CRAH27 actually moves.

candidate_interactions.rationale: Front-AONIA receive is another G10 STIR duration-long. A global-tightening spillover that lifts CRAH27 also tends to pin or lift October AONIA; it stacks the book's main adverse instead of diversifying it, and packs a 21.5bp RBA meeting binary on top.

Same-direction STIR receive as the owned CORRA. AU housing is a different micro story, but the shared factor versus the book's adverse is global hawkish rates beta. Seat conflict (mean-reverter long vs positioning-cynic short) plus thin Mar-27 OI (201) make it a worse second expression, not a complement.
perma-bear receive of Jun-27 AONIA 4.94 is the same residual-RBA-hike fade further out the IB strip; correlated duration versus the owned Canadian receive.

Long USDCAD is the same 'BoC does not catch up / CAD stays cheap' factor as receive-CORRA, expressed in spot. If Canada delivers the priced path, both the rates long and the FX long lose together; it concentrates the adverse instead of offsetting it. FX after 2026-09-18 is unobserved.

Short AUDCAD can profit if a BoC hike strengthens CAD (AUDCAD down), so it partially offsets the book's CA-catch-up adverse. That overlay is incoherent with the owned receive: it pays when the rates thesis is wrong and costs CAD-weakness when the rates thesis is right. Not a clean hedge.

Paying SR3H7 is a different sovereign (US terminal after a delivered hike), not a hedge of CRAH27. Canada-specific catch-up can reprice CORRA without SOFR rising; a joint global selloff would help the SOFR short while hurting the CORRA long, but that is incidental correlation, not an expression of the owned thesis.
Paying the 4.735 peak is the same US-terminal overlay as SOFR_2027-03 further out the strip; diversifies country, does not offset BoC catch-up, and is a second unarbitrated thesis.
rate-dove 2027 H-Z CRA strip receive is the same Canadian hike-fade in the locked CORRA/CRA family. Family lock forbids opening a second CRA contract as a hedge or add-on.

Canonical long of SOFR-minus-CORRA profits if CORRA rises or SOFR falls. CORRA rising is exactly the owned receive's loss, so the combo hedges the book by cancelling it when the thesis is right. It also mixes CORRA family legs.
vol-convexity 3M 25d AUDNZD put is a different asset class and NZD-extreme story; premium/IV/strike are missing so it is unmarkable and cannot OPEN.

decision.rationale: FACT: CRAH27 mark is unchanged versus entry at 3.13; 1m Dec-2026 remains 2.58; CRAZ26 remains 2.775. Trader Room is two-way and unarbitrated on this exact contract. INFERENCE: The discrepancy did not improve and did not break. ADD would be filling remaining capacity. REDUCE/CLOSE would treat energy minutes and a delivered Fed hike as invalidation even though CRAH27 did not move. HEDGE via AONIA receive stacks G10 duration into the same global-tightening adverse; HEDGE via USDCAD long concentrates the same BoC-does-not-catch-up beta in spot; AUDCAD short is a CAD-strength overlay that pays when the rates thesis is wrong and costs when it is right; SOFR pay is a second US-terminal thesis that does not offset Canada-specific catch-up. CORRA/CRA family lock forbids a second CRA contract as a hedge. NO_TRADE is the empty-book stance; HOLD is the explicit keep on pm-pragmatist-4e0cbc4e0b05. Conviction 55 is a one-point haircut from 56 for a more confirmed global-tightening cluster as a watch item, not a de-risk. UNKNOWN: next Canadian labor/CPI cluster. Trusted code hydrates mids; no invented levels.
